mapper.select: select distinct v.vouch_num, /*凭证编号*/ v.bus_vouchnum /*业务凭证编号*/ from BOK_VOUCH_MAIN v inner join BOK_VOUCH_DETAIL vd on v.vouch_num = vd.vouch_num where v.com_table_id in ('8103', '8105') and vd.happen_amt < 0 and v.bookset_id = #{booksetId} and v.book_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{bookDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and vd.busi_id = #{busiId}
